'''Vibbo''' was a thug who worked with the [[spicerunner]] gang known as the [[Spice Runners of Kijimi]], alongside [[Vicii]]. The two thugs accompanied the Spice Runners' leader, [[Zorii Bliss]], to confront [[Poe Dameron]], [[Resistance]] member and former Spice Runner who returned to [[Kijimi]] on a [[Mission to Kijimi|mission]]. [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] quickly intercepted the thugs, knocking them unconscious. The two thugs were taken back to the Spice Runners' [[Spice Runners' Den|den]], and Vibbo woke up unable to remember returning there. The Spice Runners were later forced to escape the [[First Order]], and Vibbo planned to hide. Shortly afterward, Kijimi was [[Destruction of Kijimi|destroyed]] by the ''[[Derriphan]]'', a [[Star Destroyer]] of the [[Sith Eternal]]'s [[fleet]], the [[Final Order]].<ref name="TROS Expanded" />
